reviews.text: Thank you, Lucilla Angelini, we're delighted to hear your positive feedback about Arcaplanet! Thank you so much for your trust.
Thanks, Frank Pax, your little stars made us shine! Come back and visit us.

Unfortunately, my experience at this store was ruined by the staff's total lack of politeness and courtesy.
While checking the contents of a package I'd just picked up, I was treated impatiently and rudely by the clerk simply for temporarily setting the box down. Being greeted with kindness should be a priority, especially when dealing with customers.
I definitely won't be returning.
Thank you, Natálie Jelínková, your little stars made us shine! Come back and visit us.
Thank you, Manu Vincenzi, for taking the time to share your review with us! Come back soon to visit us at Arcaplanet stores!

Fantastic shop
The sales assistants are kind, patient, and excellent.

Prices aren't always inviting, but there are plenty of products, many of them truly good! The staff are helpful, and some are surprisingly generous and professional, with excellent interaction and listening skills, and a willingness to help, not just with the purchase!
Excellent shop. Very friendly staff. Prices are average, but the deals are helpful.
